The TA access has the following advantages: (1) direct and co-axial access; (2) shorter distance; and (3) better control during deployment. The TA is also the first choice for patients with peripheral vascular disease. The TS route also has several advantages, including being less invasive and can be done under local anesthesia. However, the TS access route can cause an iatrogenic atrial septal defect (ASD), and some patients (16.5%) required an ASD occluder.
